_watchlist_note: Curated seed list of Solana meme-coin KOLs. These are public X accounts commonly followed by meme traders — VERIFY and CURATE for yourself, handles change and accounts get compromised. Add the callers you actually trust; remove any you don't. `weight` is advisory (1 = normal, 2 = high-signal).

broadSearch._note: Optional discovery beyond the watchlist for the aggressive tier. Off by default: noisier and uses more API reads. When on, only tweets from accounts above minFollowers count.

aggressive._note: Earliest social signal, minimal on-chain gate. More alerts, more noise/rugs.

confirmed._note: Balanced: multiple credible callers AND on-chain safety. Fewer, higher-quality alerts.

telegram._note: Dedicated bot for meme-coin alerts. PREFER the env vars MEMECOIN_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / MEMECOIN_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID over putting secrets here. If both env vars are set they win. Leave blank to only print to stdout.
